description: PROPOSAL ONLY — validate candidate evidence derived from an independently executed gh attestation verify --format json result without claiming cryptographic verification inside PlanGate.

required: exactly one gh verified attestation entry
statement subject sha256 equals raw capture-manifest file SHA-256

trust_notes: GitHub CLI documents that signature.certificate and verifiedTimestamps contain values that cannot be manipulated by the originating workflow when the JSON came from successful gh attestation verify.
PlanGate does not execute gh in this slice, so a JSON file that merely has that shape is still candidate evidence and can be forged outside the repository.
statement.predicate is never used for trust or promotion because GitHub documents it as workflow-controllable metadata.
The candidate binds the attested subject digest to the exact raw bytes of the external capture-manifest file, not only to its internal canonical manifest_hash.

The next promotion gate must execute gh attestation verify in an independently administered environment with strict signer/source/self-hosted-runner policy and preserve verifiable provenance for that execution.
non_goals: adding gh attestation verify to gh_exec.py
creating or editing active GitHub Actions workflows
